name: ZER0-G
description: Anti-gravity racing over Neon City after midnight. A cup of three courses, one with a pipe you ride round, one with a drum you ride over. 18 machines, 30 racers, online races. Arrows to fly, Space to drift, Shift for nitro. Open source: github.com/witnesstodark/zer0-g

credits.by: Stefan Vaskevich and Mr. Mak, all original
